prompt: Small KMP library (JVM + iOS) wrapping a weather REST API, published to Maven Central, called from Android and Swift. Design the public surface: client entry point, forecast result type, error representation. Age well, don't break binary compatibility.
assertions: Public surface uses explicit return/property types throughout (no inferred public return types)
Errors modeled as a sealed hierarchy (not a growable public data class, not a bare RuntimeException/IllegalStateException)
Forecast result type is NOT a growable public `data class` (interface, regular class, or sealed) to preserve binary compatibility

Construction goes through a factory or builder; NO public constructor whose JVM descriptor will move as config grows (no public defaulted-param constructor planned to gain params) -- the binary-compat trap
commonMain stays platform-free: no java.*/android.*/platform.Foundation.* in the public surface
Names a CONCRETE publishing/iOS-interop mechanism (api() for ABI-visible deps, single-macOS publish, XCFramework, or SKIE) -- not just generic Swift-bridging prose
